    A profile edit fails
    Correct the highlighted required fields and choose a summer cycle. Previous saved details remain unchanged after an invalid save. Ask the member to correct their own shared phone if it is invalid; officers cannot edit it.
    Points or dues do not save
    Refresh and check the current value before retrying. Set points to the desired type total, not an amount to add. Use a nonnegative whole number in a currently available point type’s field, then leave the field to save.
    An event does not save
    Read the errors above the form. Fill required fields, provide both coordinates or neither, use a proximity between 100 and 1,000 feet, and check the end time. Other requires its extra description. A location button failure leaves manual coordinate entry available.
    +
    The event map cannot load
    Your name, description, dates, and location stay in the form. Enter both coordinates manually, choose a saved location, or leave both coordinates blank and save the location name. Without a pin, attendance check-in is unavailable until coordinates are added. A commonly used location needs a pin.
    An imported event has issues
    Read its row number and Issues message in the preview. Supply the missing reference, title, start time, or location, or correct an unparseable date, then upload again. Changing Approved, Submitted, or Initiated is not required. For an unreadable file, upload a fresh CSV or Excel export. Only selected valid rows import.
    Attendance cannot load or nobody can check in
    Choose Refresh attendance or Try again. Verify the meeting’s coordinates at the venue and its proximity in feet. Ask members to allow location and use the secure club URL. Do not create another event just to retry.
    There are no pending requests
    This can mean all requests have been reviewed. Ask the member to check the status on Home. If the queue reports a load error, try again before assuming it is empty.
